_note: Every ref -> symbol decision. 'stock' symbols were verified pin-set exact against the generator. 'local' symbols carry pin numbers copied from the generator and are NOT datasheet-verified.

C_TAP.value: directional/coupled tap after the BPF/LNA (TODO(unverified) coupling)

FLT_433_A.rationale: the 433 MHz BPF part is not selected (the freeze only requires 'a 433 MHz BPF'), so no stock SAW symbol can be correct. The footprint Filter:Filter_SAW-6 has pads 1-6; the generator connects only 1 (in) and 2 (out). Pads 3-6 are emitted and left unconnected: their real function is unknown at this milestone

FLT_433_B.rationale: the 433 MHz BPF part is not selected (the freeze only requires 'a 433 MHz BPF'), so no stock SAW symbol can be correct. The footprint Filter:Filter_SAW-6 has pads 1-6; the generator connects only 1 (in) and 2 (out). Pads 3-6 are emitted and left unconnected: their real function is unknown at this milestone

J_2450_TX.value: 2.45 GHz TX antenna port (SMA; no PA on the PCBA)

J_LNA_FEED.value: coax feed to the masthead LNA (SMA)

J_PWR.rationale: 2-way terminal block, matching the TerminalBlock_4Ucon footprint

Q_LNA_SW.value: load switch / resettable limiter (ADL5240 must NOT share this rail)
Q_LNA_SW.rationale: the freeze allows 'load switch OR resettable limiter' and no part is selected, so no stock symbol can be correct. Generic 5-pin symbol with the generator's numbers: 1 IN, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 FLT, 5 OUT

TEE1.value: Mini-Circuits ZFBT-4R2GW+ bias tee (masthead feed boundary, NOT in series)
TEE1.rationale: bias tee as its 3-pin interface; footprint is a 1x03 header

TEE2.rationale: bias tee as its 3-pin interface; footprint is a 1x03 header

U_DET.value: AD8318ACPZ-R7 log detector (68mA typ, 82mA max at 25C)
U_DET.rationale: no stock KiCad symbol. Pins 1-8 and 17 (EP) are the GENERATOR'S logical numbers, not a datasheet reading. Footprint pads 1-17; pads 9-16 are unmapped -- same open item as U_VGA

U_FLASH.rationale: stock serial-NOR symbol: 1 ~CS, 2 DO/IO1, 3 ~WP/IO2, 4 GND, 5 DI/IO0, 6 CLK, 7 ~HOLD/IO3, 8 VCC, 9 EP -- every pad the generator asserts

U_LDO.rationale: stock AP2112K SOT-25 symbol: 1 IN, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 NC, 5 OUT. The generator deliberately omits pin 4 (NC); that NC pin gets a no-connect flag, not a ground

U_MCU.rationale: stock symbol carries the same physical QFN pads 1-57 the corrected generator map uses (TESTEN=19, QSPI_SS=56, USB_DM=46, USB_DP=47, ADC_AVDD=43, VREG_VOUT=45); pin-set verified exact below

U_REG.rationale: stock TPS6216x DSG symbol: 1 PGND, 2 VIN, 3 EN, 4 AGND, 5 FB, 6 VOS, 7 SW, 8 PG, 9 PAD -- the corrected regulator pinout, pin for pin

U_VGA.rationale: no stock KiCad symbol among the 223 installed libraries. Pins 1-8 and 33 (EP) are the GENERATOR'S logical numbers, not a datasheet reading. Footprint Package_CSP:LFCSP-32-1EP has pads 1-33, so pads 9-32 are unmapped -- a real pin-assignment task for schematic review

Y1.rationale: 4-pad crystal; footprint pads 2 and 4 are case ground, matching the generator's Y1 mapping
